references.text: God gives wisdom to craftsmen to make the priestly garments, a theme of divine wisdom given to artists.
Parallel text where God fills Bezalel and Oholiab with wisdom and skill in all kinds of crafts.
Describes women who spun with their hands, including blue, purple, scarlet yarn, and fine linen.
Continuation of the text about craftsmen whom God has given wisdom and understanding to carry out the work.
Instructions on making the tabernacle with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen.
Hiram from Tyre was filled with wisdom and skill to perform all kinds of bronze work, a similar divine endowment.
Huram-Abi is described as skilled in working with purple, blue, fine linen, and scarlet, as well as all kinds of engraving.
The Lord's wisdom in giving counsel and great insight shows God's role as the source of all wisdom and skill.
Every good gift and every perfect gift comes from above, from the Father of lights - God is the source of all gifts and abilities.
Both verses confirm that both men and women were filled with the same divine wisdom to carry out the specific crafts.
31:3 is the prophetic promise of wisdom that 35:35 confirms has been fulfilled.
